title: NSGo game UI screen (version 1)
description: ScreenDoc is the root of a versioned *.screen.yaml HUD or menu screen definition.

version.description: Version is the schema version; it must equal ScreenFormatVersion (1).

uid.description: UID is an optional stable ID for the screen file, kept across renames by game index and game mv.

name.description: Name is the screen's human-readable name (for example "hud" or "pause").

designWidth.description: DesignWidth is the authored reference canvas width in virtual points (for example 640).

designHeight.description: DesignHeight is the authored reference canvas height in virtual points (for example 360).

scaleMode.description: ScaleMode controls how the screen scales to different window sizes: fit (default), fill, stretch, or integer.

nodes.description: Nodes are the top-level UI nodes of the screen, rendered in slice order.

ScreenNodeDoc.description: ScreenNodeDoc is one node in a *.screen.yaml tree.

id.description: ID uniquely identifies this node within the screen.

type.description: Type selects the widget or container kind.

anchor.description: Anchor positions the node relative to the screen or safe area: one of the nine anchor points or fill.

offset.description: Offset shifts the node from its anchor in virtual points. For right and bottom anchors, positive values inset inward from that edge.

safeArea.description: SafeArea keeps the node inside the display safe area (away from notches and home indicators). Nil defaults to true for non-fill anchors and false for fill.

sizeMode.description: SizeMode selects whether width is fixed ("fixed", the default) or sizes to fit localized text ("fit_text") on label and button nodes.

width.description: Width is the node's fixed width in virtual points (0 uses intrinsic or container-determined width).

height.description: Height is the node's fixed height in virtual points (0 uses intrinsic or container-determined height).

padding.description: Padding is the node's inner padding in virtual points (vbox, hbox, label, button).

spacing.description: Spacing is the gap between children of a vbox, hbox, or sprite_row in virtual points.

textKey.description: TextKey names a localized string in the project's l10n tables (such as "hud.hint.lever") for label, button, and touch_button nodes. Screen files store localization keys rather than literal text.

focusOrder.description: FocusOrder sets the explicit keyboard/gamepad focus traversal order (1-based; 0 means not explicitly ordered) on button and touch_button nodes.

touchHitSize.description: TouchHitSize is the touch target diameter in virtual points for touch_stick, touch_button, or touch-interactive buttons.

deviceClasses.description: DeviceClasses optionally restricts the node and its subtree to the listed device classes (for example [phone, tablet]). Empty shows on all devices; nested nodes must overlap their parent's allowed classes.

sprite.description: Sprite is a project-relative path to a sprite image or atlas file (for example "art/ui/heart.png") for sprite_row nodes, followed by refs and game mv.

spriteFrame.description: SpriteFrame optionally names a frame inside a sprite atlas when Sprite points to an atlas JSON file on a sprite_row node.

spriteCount.description: SpriteCount is the number of repeated icons in a sprite_row (defaults to 1 when Sprite is set).

under.description: Under is a project-relative path to the image_progress background layer image, drawn in full first.

progress.description: Progress is a project-relative path to the image_progress fill layer image, revealed by the value along Fill.

over.description: Over is a project-relative path to the image_progress foreground layer image, drawn in full last.

fill.description: Fill picks how an image_progress reveals its progress image: left_to_right (the default), right_to_left, top_to_bottom, bottom_to_top, center_h, center_v, clockwise, or counter_clockwise.

startAngle.description: StartAngle is the image_progress radial fill's starting angle in degrees (0 points right, positive is clockwise).

span.description: Span is the image_progress radial fill's full sweep in degrees (0 defaults to 360).

min.description: Min is the image_progress range's lower bound (defaults to 0).

max.description: Max is the image_progress range's upper bound (defaults to 1 when both min and max are 0).

value.description: Value is the image_progress node's initial value; game code updates the widget's Value at runtime.

fontSize.description: FontSize overrides the text font size in virtual points for label, button, and touch_button nodes.

textColor.description: TextColor is an optional CSS color string parsed with core.ParseColor for text (label, button, touch_button) or the thumbstick knob (touch_stick).

background.description: Background is an optional CSS color string parsed with core.ParseColor for the node's fill (all node types except image_progress; icon fallback tint on sprite_row and ring base on touch_stick).

cornerRadius.description: CornerRadius is an optional corner radius in virtual points (vbox, hbox, container, label, button, color_rect).

children.description: Children are nested child nodes for container types (vbox, hbox, container).

ScreenOffsetDoc.description: ScreenOffsetDoc is an offset from a node's anchor point in virtual points. For right and bottom anchors, positive X and Y values move inward away from that edge.

x.description: X is the horizontal offset in virtual points.

y.description: Y is the vertical offset in virtual points.

ScreenPaddingDoc.description: ScreenPaddingDoc holds inner padding in virtual points.

top.description: Top is the top inner padding in virtual points.

right.description: Right is the right inner padding in virtual points.

bottom.description: Bottom is the bottom inner padding in virtual points.

left.description: Left is the left inner padding in virtual points.
